description: Contract addresses (Solana and Robinhood Chain) posted in the followed Telegram call chats in the last 1-120 minutes: first seen, how many chats posted it, our own price and market cap at the first call (pump.fun curve or on-chain pool reads only), the move since and the max since, and its stage (curve band or pool age). Public channels are named with their @username; private chats appear only as counts. Data rewritten every 20 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 120 s. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).
name: sol_calls_live
